This is not a tutorial—it’s a deployment blueprint.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms fail because they are built for their owners, not for you. Stripe and PayPal lock you out based on geography, not merit. COREMERCH’s infrastructure is designed for sovereignty. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting—both free and globally accessible. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring zero server costs. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee and no KYC. File delivery is handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both free and reliable. This stack is not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure. You own the code. You own the deployment. You own the customer relationship. No platform can shut you down. No subscription can expire. This is commerce infrastructure built for creators who choose ownership over rent.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather your assets. First, your digital product—ebook, course, or template—must be finalized and ready for delivery. Second, create a NOWPayments account to generate API keys for payment processing. Choose Bitcoin or stablecoins like USDT on BSC for low fees. Third, set up a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting. Fourth, prepare a Google Drive folder or Cloudflare R2 bucket to store your product files. Fifth, draft your sales page copy and product descriptions. Sixth, decide your pricing in USD—NOWPayments will convert it to crypto at transaction time. Seventh, ensure you have a domain or subdomain to point to your hosted store. If you’re using Cloudflare, configure DNS settings in advance. Eighth, install the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all blueprints and templates. This kit includes step-by-step guides and pre-built scripts to accelerate deployment. With these elements in place, you’re ready to build.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments. Log in, create a new payment gateway, and select your preferred cryptocurrency. Copy the API key—you’ll need it for webhook integration. Next, deploy your frontend. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your sales page. Both platforms offer free SSL and global CDN. Link your domain to the hosted site. For backend logic, use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Workers are faster and more scalable, while Apps Script is simpler for beginners. Write a script to verify payments via NOWPayments’ webhook and trigger file delivery. Upload your product to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and generate shareable links. Test the pipeline by simulating a payment. Ensure the webhook fires correctly and the file is delivered instantly. This pipeline is your core infrastructure—it processes payments, verifies transactions, and delivers products without human intervention.
Platforms lock you out. Infrastructure lets you build.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your pipeline is tested, go live. Share your sales page link with your audience. Monitor your NOWPayments dashboard for incoming transactions. When a payment is confirmed on-chain, the webhook will trigger your backend script. The script will verify the payment, retrieve the file from Google Drive or R2, and send a secure download link to the buyer. Your first transaction proves the infrastructure works. Document the process for future reference. Track the transaction fee—NOWPayments charges 0.5%, and the blockchain fee is typically under $0.10 on BSC or TRON. Communicate with your buyer to confirm delivery. This is not just a sale—it’s proof that your sovereign stack operates independently of platforms. You’ve built infrastructure that cannot be taken away.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your stack live, focus on scaling. Add more products by replicating the delivery pipeline. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to manage orders and customer data. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email delivery if you’re sending receipts. Optimize your sales page for conversions—test headlines, pricing, and calls-to-action. Diversify payment options by adding more cryptocurrencies via NOWPayments. Monitor transaction fees and recommend low-cost networks like BSC or Solana to buyers. Automate customer support with pre-written emails or FAQs. Reinvest profits into marketing or product development. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes a scaling playbook to guide this process. Your infrastructure is now a platform—one you own, control, and expand on your terms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To accept Bitcoin for ebook sales without Stripe or PayPal, deploy COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197). Host your sales page on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Use NOWPayments for crypto payment processing with a 0.5% fee. Deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Write backend logic in Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate delivery. Test the pipeline, go live, and scale by adding more products. This infrastructure is sovereign—you own it, control it, and operate it without platform dependency.
Own your payment pipeline. Own your delivery system. Own your future.

Ready to deploy your sovereign commerce stack? The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints, templates, and guides to build your infrastructure. From payment processing to file delivery, every component is designed for ownership, not rent. Access the kit at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and start selling your ebooks, courses, and digital products on your terms.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Finalize your digital product and prepare it for delivery. 2. Create a NOWPayments account and generate API keys. 3. Set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 4. Configure Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage. 5. Draft your sales page copy and product descriptions. 6. Decide your USD pricing and select cryptocurrencies for payment. 7. Point your domain to the hosted sales page. 8. Write backend scripts to verify payments and deliver files. 9. Test the pipeline with a simulated transaction. 10. Go live and share your sales page with your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes pre-built templates and step-by-step guides. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script are designed for non-developers. Focus on following the blueprints—no coding expertise required.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. For low fees, recommend Bitcoin, USDT on BSC, Solana, or TRON to your buyers. The system converts USD prices to crypto at transaction time.
How are files delivered securely?

Files are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and delivered via secure, time-limited links. The backend script generates these links only after payment verification, ensuring unauthorized access is prevented.
What happens if a payment fails?

If a payment fails, the webhook does not trigger, and no file is delivered. The buyer must retry the transaction. NOWPayments provides real-time payment status, so you can monitor and communicate with buyers if needed.
Can I scale this infrastructure for multiple products?
Yes. Replicate the delivery pipeline for each product. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to manage orders. The scaling playbook in the Complete Builder Kit provides detailed instructions for expansion.
Sovereign commerce is not a workaround—it’s the new standard.
